title: Who am I?
subtitle: From educator to developer
paragraphs: I'm studying system development at NBI/Handelsakademin in Gothenburg. With a solid foundation in C# .NET and relational databases, I build robust backend logic, but my passion doesn't stop there.

Through self-study, I've embraced the modern frontend stack. Currently, I'm creating fast, responsive web solutions with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. For me, development is about understanding the big picture - from database architecture to user experience.

hybridSkill.title: Hybrid Skillset
hybridSkill.description: My years as a high school teacher and entrepreneur have given me a unique ability to structure complex problems, communicate solutions and drive projects forward with a business-oriented mindset.
